title: Reading the Monthly Rider Premium From an Optional Supplemental Benefit Rider Account
content:
Where a member holding a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan application also holds a rider under the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders, the monthly rider premium is read from the rider premium charges standing on that rider's own account.

**Clause 1.** Where at least 2 rider premium charges have been posted to the member's optional supplemental benefit rider account in the last 6 months and the rider carries rider premium owing, the monthly rider premium is the rider premium charged to that account in the last 6 months spread over those charges.

**Clause 2.** Where the rider carries rider premium owing and fewer than 2 rider premium charges have been posted to that account in the last 6 months, the monthly rider premium is the most recent rider premium charge standing on that account, and is nothing where no rider premium charge stands on it at all.

**Clause 3.** Where the rider carries no rider premium owing, or the member holds no optional supplemental benefit rider, the monthly rider premium is nothing.

Clause 3 is reached on the state of the rider balance alone: a rider carrying nothing owing, and a member with no rider at all, both give a monthly rider premium of nothing however many rider premium charges stand on any account.

### Worked through on hypothetical figures

*A rider carrying rider premium owing, with 3 rider premium charges posted in the last 6 months of 30.00, 30.00 and 36.00 USD.* At least 2 charges stand inside the 6 months and the rider carries rider premium owing, so the monthly rider premium is 96.00 USD spread over those 3 charges, which is 32.00 USD.

*A rider carrying rider premium owing, with 1 rider premium charge posted in the last 6 months of 28.50 USD and an older charge of 24.00 USD.* Fewer than 2 charges stand inside the 6 months, so the monthly rider premium is the most recent rider premium charge standing on the account, 28.50 USD.

*A rider carrying nothing owing.* The monthly rider premium is nothing.
